title: Reinstating Finch Note Value on Returned Merchandise — Finch Circle Loyalty Program Returns Desk
content:
## The rule

In the Finch Circle Loyalty Program, the returned unit is the member's purchase record most recently received back in returned status, and the original note is the Finch Note redeemed on that unit. For a refunded return this policy handles, and only for such a return of merchandise paid in part with Finch Notes, one new reinstatement note naming the return and the original note is issued for the reinstated note value, rounded half up to the cent; the original note's expiry rule for the new note, the one reinstatement per return and original note, and every other note rule remain under the base rules.

**Observable effect.** A new note marked as a return reinstatement, naming the return and the original note, appears on the membership with its own code, and the Finch Notes balance rises by its value.

## Issuing the note: `reinstate_returned_note_1c0adac4`

**Capability.** Customer care issues a new Finch Note that reinstates note value spent on merchandise the member returned and was refunded for. One new note with its own code, marked as a return reinstatement and naming the return and the original note, is issued today with the given value and last valid day, and the membership's Finch Notes balance rises by that value. The member sees the new note in the app at once.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: customer care unlocks `reinstate_returned_note_1c0adac4` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `membership_id` | the reference number of the Finch Circle membership, as returned by the membership lookup | identifier |
| `return_id` | the reference number of the refunded return record the note value is reinstated for, as returned by the return lookup | identifier |
| `original_note_code` | the code of the Finch Note that was spent on the returned merchandise, exactly as it appears in the member's note history | copied character for character, verbatim |
| `note_amount` | the value of the new note | USD, 2 decimal places, positive, rounded half up to the cent |
| `expiry_date` | the last day the new note can be redeemed | a calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD |

**Return.** A receipt with: `status` ("issued" when the note was created); `note_code` (code of the new note, FN- followed by 8 characters); `note_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places); `issue_date` (YYYY-MM-DD); `expiry_date` (YYYY-MM-DD); `notes_balance` (the new Finch Notes balance, USD, 2 decimal places).

## Points of judgement

- **Which note is the original note?** The Finch Note redeemed on the returned unit, as the note history shows it.
- **Can the note value go back to the card instead?** No; note value is reinstated as a new note.
